metadata.description:
As monsoon sets in, Delhi gets us excited about many things, both sweet and savoury. And the best place to enjoy these delish dishes in the Capital is the bustling lanes of Old Delhi that liven up with a huge array of irresistible and timeless monsoon special dishes. 

We recently visited Old Delhi to satiate the cravings for some of our favourite monsoon teats and we weren't disappointed at all. Let's take you on a special tour featuring the best of Old Delhi monsoon treats, that you shouldn't be missing this season.
